verdict.rationale: AnyDesk's own CLI docs describe pairing it with software deployment tools to install and configure AnyDesk on many devices without per-machine setup, and they include a batch script example. The REST API and its Python module can list all registered clients and export session data to CSV in one pass. Beyond that, true bulk actions are mostly left to user scripting: the multi-device fan-out comes from external deployment tools, and the API's mutating calls (close a session, change an alias, comment) act on one item at a time. Missing for 10: native multi-select or batch actions in the portal or API, bulk updates or removals across many clients or sessions, and independent hands-on corroboration.
